The correct statement(s) about P, Q, S and T is(are) :

options.content: Q on treatment with ethanol generates an aromatic aldehyde.

en.explanation:
The compound is an aliphatic aldehyde because it has the aldehyde group attached to an aliphatic carbon chain (not to an aromatic ring).

Compound S has a phenolic –OH group. Phenols give a positive phthalein dye test since the –OH group attached to the benzene ring reacts in this test to form a colored product.

Compound P contains only one nitro group . This means it is a mononitro derivative.

Compound T is an azo compound, which has the general structure . Azo compounds are usually highly colored due to extended conjugation in their structure.
